hook.vo: Late three times this week. Same reason.
School bus is honking. I'm still sock hunting.
My son wore my socks to school.
I counted 23 socks. Not one pair.
I lose four minutes a day to socks.
My husband says he never loses socks.
My sister heard me yelling about socks.
I haven't worn matching socks since May.
Hallway hopping is my morning cardio now.
One small thing fixed my 7:45 chaos.
Are your socks matching right now? Check.
